title: DriveGuard Essential comprehensive motor cover
text: DriveGuard Essential is the entry comprehensive motor policy from Liwan Crest Insurance for private cars registered in the UAE. It covers accidental damage, fire and theft of your car, plus third-party bodily injury and third-party property damage up to AED 2,000,000. Repairs are carried out at one of our approved non-agency garages, whatever the age of the car. Depreciation on parts: a flat 15% is deducted from the cost of every replaced part on every claim, from the first day of cover and regardless of the vehicle's age. The only exception is windscreen and window glass, which is replaced in full. Standard excess: AED 500 per claim. Drivers under 25 years old, or who have held a UAE driving licence for less than 1 year, pay an additional excess of AED 1,000 on top of the standard excess. Roadside assistance: up to 2 call-outs per policy year, with towing up to 30 km. Replacement car: not included. Oman cover: available as an add-on for AED 150 per year, covering own damage and third-party liability while driving in Oman. Personal accident cover for the driver: AED 200,000. Personal belongings left in the car are not covered. Natural perils such as flood and hail are covered only if you buy the natural perils add-on for AED 250 per year.

title: DriveGuard Premier comprehensive motor cover
text: DriveGuard Premier is our top comprehensive motor policy for private cars registered in the UAE. It covers accidental damage, fire and theft, natural perils such as flood and hail, and third-party bodily injury and third-party property damage up to AED 3,500,000. Agency repair: cars up to 5 years old from first registration are repaired at the manufacturer's authorised agency workshop. Older cars are repaired at an approved non-agency garage. Depreciation on parts: none for cars up to 3 years old. For older cars, 10% is deducted from the cost of replaced parts for each full year beyond the third, up to a maximum of 40%. Standard excess: AED 350 per claim. Drivers under 25 years old pay an additional excess of AED 750. Roadside assistance: unlimited call-outs, with towing up to 100 km per call-out. Replacement car: a saloon hire car for up to 10 days per claim, or a cash benefit of AED 100 per day if you prefer, while your car is in a garage after an accident covered by the policy. Oman cover: included at no extra cost. Personal accident cover for the driver and each passenger: AED 200,000. Personal belongings in the car: up to AED 3,000 per claim, excluding cash and jewellery. NCD protection can be added for 10% of the premium. Damage caused while driving off-road is excluded.

title: Motor claims procedure, effective 1 March 2024
text: This procedure applies to all motor claims for accidents on or after 1 March 2024. Report the accident to the police, or use the police smart app for minor accidents, and obtain the police report. Your car cannot be repaired under the policy without it. Notify Liwan Crest Insurance within 7 days of the accident, through the app, the claims line or by email. Upload the police report, photos of the damage, your driving licence, the vehicle registration card (mulkiya) and the Emirates ID of the driver. Survey: after notification we arrange an inspection by our surveyor within 3 working days at the Al Quoz survey centre, or at your location for an additional AED 100. Once the survey is done, we send the repair authorisation to the garage within 2 working days. Total loss: a car is treated as a total loss if the estimated repair cost is more than 50% of the insured value. We then pay the insured value less the excess. Repairs at our approved garages are guaranteed for 12 months. If the other driver was at fault, we will try to recover your excess from their insurer and refund it to you once recovered.

title: Motor claims procedure, effective 1 July 2026 (replaces the March 2024 version)
text: This procedure replaces the version effective 1 March 2024 and applies to all accidents on or after 1 July 2026. Step 1: report the accident to the police, or use the police smart app for minor accidents with no injuries, and obtain the police report. No repair can be authorised without it. Step 2: notify Liwan Crest Insurance within 24 hours of the accident, through the app, the 24-hour claims line on 800 5426 or claims@liwancrest.ae. This is a strict condition: late notification without a good reason, such as being in hospital, can lead to the claim being declined. Upload the police report, photos of the damage, the driver's licence, the vehicle registration card (mulkiya) and the driver's Emirates ID. Step 3: survey. Our surveyor inspects the car within 2 working days of notification, at the Al Quoz survey centre or, free of charge, at your home or workplace in Dubai, Sharjah or Abu Dhabi. Step 4: the repair authorisation is sent to the garage within 1 working day of the survey. Total loss: a car is treated as a total loss if the estimated repair cost is more than 60% of the insured value. We then pay the insured value less the excess, and the salvage becomes ours. Repairs at our approved garages are guaranteed for 12 months. If the other driver was at fault, we try to recover your excess from their insurer and refund it once recovered.

title: No-claims discount on motor policies
text: Liwan Crest Insurance gives a no-claims discount (NCD) on motor premiums for each consecutive claim-free year: 10% after 1 year, 15% after 2 years, 20% after 3 years and 25% after 4 or more years, which is the maximum. NCD earned with another UAE insurer is accepted if you provide a no-claims certificate or letter dated within the last 3 months. After an at-fault claim, your NCD drops back two steps at the next renewal; for example, 25% becomes 15%. A not-at-fault claim does not affect your NCD if the other party's insurer has accepted liability and the police report shows you were not at fault. Windscreen claims: unlike many insurers, we treat a windscreen or window glass replacement as an at-fault claim, so it reduces your NCD by two steps in the same way. Only a chip repair, where the glass is repaired and not replaced, has no effect on your NCD. Windscreen replacement has no excess on DriveGuard Premier and an excess of AED 250 on DriveGuard Essential. NCD protection is available on DriveGuard Premier for 10% of the premium. It allows one at-fault claim per policy year without losing NCD, but it does not cover windscreen replacement. NCD belongs to the named policyholder, not the car, and can be transferred to a new car.

title: Roadside assistance
text: Roadside assistance is included with every DriveGuard policy and is available 24 hours a day on 800 5427. Services: battery jump-start, flat tyre change using your spare, fuel delivery of up to 10 litres (you pay for the fuel), help if you are locked out, and towing to the nearest approved garage or a garage of your choice within your plan's towing distance. DriveGuard Essential includes up to 2 call-outs per policy year with towing up to 30 km. DriveGuard Premier includes unlimited call-outs with towing up to 100 km per call-out. Towing beyond the limit is charged at AED 5 per km, payable to the driver by card. Target arrival time is 60 minutes in Dubai, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi cities, and 90 minutes elsewhere in the UAE. Roadside assistance covers paved and public roads only. We do not provide off-road or desert recovery, including cars stuck in sand on unpaved tracks or dunes, even if the car is only a few metres off the road. In that case you would need a private recovery service at your own cost. Roadside assistance is not available in Oman, even where Oman cover has been added to the policy. Please stay with your vehicle, or in a safe place nearby, until help arrives.

title: HomeShield Contents cover
text: HomeShield Contents insures the belongings in your home in the UAE, for owners and tenants, with a contents sum insured from AED 50,000 to AED 500,000. It does not cover the building itself; in a rented home that is the landlord's responsibility, and in an owned flat it is usually covered by the building's own policy. Covered events include fire, theft with forced entry, storm, flood, and sudden escape of water from burst pipes, water tanks or air-conditioning units. Damage from gradual leakage, seepage or damp over time is not covered. A water damage claim carries a higher excess of AED 1,000; the standard excess for other claims is AED 250. Single-item limit: any one item is covered up to AED 7,500 unless it is listed separately on the schedule. Valuables such as jewellery, watches and gold are covered up to 30% of the contents sum insured in total. Replacement is new for old, except clothing and household linen, which are paid less a deduction for wear and tear. Underinsurance: if your contents sum insured is less than the full replacement value of everything you own, claims are reduced in proportion. Optional add-ons: accidental damage, personal belongings away from home up to AED 10,000, and domestic worker liability. Unoccupancy: theft and water damage are not covered if the home has been left empty for more than 45 consecutive days.

title: How to make a home contents claim
text: To claim under HomeShield Contents, call 800 5426 or use the app within 48 hours of discovering the loss or damage. For theft or a break-in, report it to the police within 24 hours and send us the police report. For water damage, stop the source if it is safe to do so, take photos, and keep damaged items until our loss adjuster has seen them. Documents: the completed claim form, photos, original purchase receipts or bank statements showing the purchase, warranty cards, and repair quotes. For claims above AED 15,000, a loss adjuster visits within 3 working days. We settle approved claims within 10 working days of receiving all documents, either by bank transfer or by replacement through our supplier network. Replacement through our suppliers is usually quicker, and electronics are replaced with a model of similar specification. If an item cannot be repaired, it is replaced new for old as set out in the policy, subject to the single-item limit. Clothing and household linen are paid at replacement cost less 10% for each year of age, up to a maximum deduction of 50%. If you disagree with a settlement, ask for a review within 30 days; a senior claims handler not involved in the original decision will reply within 10 working days.

title: Voyager Single Trip travel insurance
text: Voyager Single Trip covers one return journey starting from the UAE, for trips of up to 90 days. It is available to UAE residents aged up to 80 years. Benefits per insured person: emergency medical expenses up to AED 1,000,000; emergency medical evacuation and repatriation; trip cancellation up to AED 7,500; trip curtailment up to AED 7,500; checked baggage loss up to AED 3,000, with AED 750 for any one item; baggage delay of 6 hours or more, AED 500 for essentials; flight delay of AED 150 for each full 6 hours of delay, up to AED 900; and personal liability up to AED 250,000. The policy meets Schengen visa requirements. Excess: AED 250 per claim on medical expenses, cancellation and baggage, and none on flight delay. Pre-existing medical conditions are covered only if declared and accepted before purchase, for an additional premium. Winter sports cover is an optional add-on. Medical and baggage cover starts on the departure date shown on the schedule; cancellation cover starts on the date of purchase, subject to the trip cancellation rules. The policy ends when you return to the UAE or after 90 days, whichever is earlier.

title: Voyager Annual Multi-Trip travel insurance
text: Voyager Annual Multi-Trip covers any number of trips starting from the UAE during 12 months from the policy start date. Each trip can last up to 45 days. A trip that runs longer is not covered at all for any day of that trip, not just the extra days, unless you extend it with us before it reaches 45 days. It is available to UAE residents aged up to 70 years, and a family policy covers you, your spouse and children under 21, travelling together or separately. Benefits per insured person: emergency medical expenses up to AED 1,000,000; trip cancellation up to AED 10,000 per trip; trip curtailment up to AED 10,000 per trip; checked baggage loss up to AED 3,000, with AED 750 for any one item; flight delay of AED 150 for each full 6 hours, up to AED 900; and personal liability up to AED 250,000. Excess: AED 250 per claim. Travel within the UAE is not covered. The policy meets Schengen visa requirements. Pre-existing conditions are covered only if declared and accepted. The premium is payable annually. Cancellation cover for trips already booked when the annual policy starts follows the trip cancellation rules.

title: Trip cancellation cover rules
text: Trip cancellation cover on Voyager Single Trip and Voyager Annual Multi-Trip refunds the non-refundable travel and accommodation costs you lose if you must cancel before departure for a covered reason. Covered reasons include the serious illness, injury or death of you, a travelling companion or a close relative; your home being made uninhabitable by fire or flood within 7 days before departure; a jury or witness summons; being made redundant; and a visa refusal, if you applied at least 21 days before departure. Purchase timing rule: cancellation cover applies to a trip only if the policy was bought, or your annual policy was already in force, within 7 days of the date you paid the first deposit or booking payment for that trip. If you buy later than that, the policy still covers medical, baggage and delay, but not cancellation of that trip. Many insurers let you buy cancellation cover at any time before you travel; we do not. Not covered: changing your mind, fear of travel, work commitments, airline insolvency, or any reason you knew about when you bought the policy. Claims: tell us within 48 hours of learning that you need to cancel, and cancel your bookings at once to limit the loss. Send the booking invoices, cancellation invoices showing the non-refundable amount, and evidence of the reason, such as a medical certificate. The excess is AED 250 per claim.

title: Cancelling a policy and refunds
text: Cooling-off period: for HomeShield Contents and Voyager Annual Multi-Trip, you can cancel within 14 days of the start date, or of receiving the policy documents if later, and get a full refund, provided no claim has been made. A Voyager Single Trip policy can be cancelled with a full refund at any time before the departure date, if no claim has been made. Motor policies: under UAE vehicle registration rules, a DriveGuard policy cannot be cancelled mid-term while the car is still registered in your name. You can cancel only when the vehicle is sold or transferred, exported, or its registration is cancelled, and you must send proof such as the transfer certificate or the deregistration certificate. If no claim has been made, the refund is calculated on a short-period scale, not pro rata, and an administration fee of AED 100 is deducted: cancelled within 3 months of the start, 70% of the annual premium; within 6 months, 45%; within 9 months, 20%; after 9 months, no refund. If any claim has been paid in the policy year, no refund is made. Home and travel policies cancelled after the cooling-off period are refunded on the same short-period scale, less the AED 100 fee. Refunds are paid to the original card or bank account within 10 working days.

title: Premium payments and renewal
text: You can pay premiums by debit or credit card, Apple Pay, bank transfer, or cheque at our Business Bay office. Instalments: annual premiums above AED 3,000 can be split into 4 quarterly instalments by card, with a surcharge of 5% of the premium. If an instalment fails and is not paid within 10 days, the policy is cancelled. Motor renewal: there is no grace period for motor policies. Cover ends at 11:59 pm on the expiry date shown on your schedule, and you cannot legally drive or renew the vehicle registration without valid insurance. We send renewal quotes 30 days before expiry, and you can renew up to 30 days in advance without losing any days of cover, because the new policy starts the day after the old one ends. Home and travel renewal: HomeShield Contents and Voyager Annual Multi-Trip have a grace period of 15 days after expiry, during which the policy can be renewed without a fresh declaration, but no loss or damage during those 15 days is covered unless the renewal premium has been received. Motor premiums depend on the car's value and model, the driver's age and licence history, the no-claims discount, the emirate of registration and repair costs, which are reviewed every year.
